Observations & Corrective Actions

16: At the 3-compartment sink, the sanitizing solution (150 ppm) measured below 200 ppm quat residual. Corrective Action: Discussed manually adding more sanitizer to have the correct concentration and calling again to get the sanitation tower serviced.

22: At the open air cooler containing packaged salads, the following salads measured greater than 41ºF: Cobb salads (45ºF-47ºF), and garden salad (44ºF). Corrective Action: One Cobb Salad was voluntarily discarded and discussed cold holding requirements.

47: At the three door reach-in refrigerator containing packaged cut fruit and snack boxes, the doors were observed with torn and/or missing gaskets.
